text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Top Road. It's your birthday today, 
right? Let's hit up a family restaurant so 
I can celebrate with you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wah, thank you so much, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but could you wait for a bit? Teacher 
asked me to collect the notebooks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Ain't you taking on a bit too much? 
Rely on your classmates a little more."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"No, this is all part of the Class Rep's 
job! I want to do my best for everyone's 
sake!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Fine. I'll help, so let's get it 
over with quickly. I'll take the 
warehouse. You go to teach's office.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just let me handle it. Knowing when to 
delegate is part of being a leader, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you plan on staying at the top, you'd 
better learn to rely on others, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thank you so much! In that case, I'll 
happily take you up on your offer today!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me! Alright, let's meet 
at the front gate when we're done~.
